# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

If you've found a security issue affecting this site or our learners' data,
please email **hello@aibankinginstitute.com** with:

- A description of the issue and steps to reproduce
- The affected endpoint or surface
- Your suggested severity

We aim to acknowledge within 48 hours and to patch critical issues within
7 days. We do not currently run a paid bug bounty, but we will credit
researchers who report vulnerabilities responsibly.

The machine-readable version of this policy is published at
[`/.well-known/security.txt`](https://www.aibankinginstitute.com/.well-known/security.txt).

## Out of scope

- Social engineering of our staff
- Physical attacks
- Denial-of-service / volumetric attacks
- Issues in third-party services we use (Supabase, Stripe, Vercel, Resend,
  MailerLite) — please report those directly to the vendor.

## Supported versions

This is a continuously deployed web application; only the currently deployed
production version at https://www.aibankinginstitute.com is supported. There
are no released versions or long-term support branches.
